policy: Only equipment-specific numeric coordinates with linked location evidence are supplied to the map marker engine.

equipment.name: Lunar Surface Magnetometer
equipment.coordinatePrecision: Reported to three decimal places; absolute positional accuracy not stated
equipment.uncertaintyNotes: NASA-SP-235 prints the instrument location as 2.970° S, 23.350° W. The displayed three decimal places preserve the source notation only; the report does not state absolute positional accuracy, survey accuracy, or a verified uncertainty radius. These instrument-specific coordinates are distinct from the Apollo 12 ALSEP array deployment-site coordinates.
equipment.locationDescription: Apollo 12 Lunar Surface Magnetometer location, 2.970° S, 23.350° W, as printed in NASA-SP-235.

excluded_coordinate_notes: MOON-EQ-0002: numeric coordinates describe ALSEP_array_deployment_site, not an independently established equipment position; excluded from equipment markers.
